rules: Every file under tests/fixtures/ (except broker/ and these lists) is listed here with its sha256, its licence and where it comes from. Only CC0-1.0, public-domain or own-work. A photo needs its page URL and author; own work names the script that makes it; a golden reference names the model id, the pinned revision and the backend it came from. None may match tests/fixtures/denylist-runonweb-samples.sha256.

source.author: Joselodos
source.file: The 960-pixel-wide rendering that Wikimedia Commons serves of the original, with its Exif block (author fields) removed; the image data is untouched.

files.purpose: cutout: a photo with one clear subject (a dog lying on grass) whose background the site removes.

source.how: Run with ELFFUSS_AI_RECORD=cutout: the alpha channel of the PNG the cutout page gave for foto.jpg in configuration B, saved as a grey PNG.

files.checked: Against an independent run of the same ONNX file with ONNX Runtime for the CPU, Pillow's bilinear resize and torch's bilinear upsampling: IoU 0.9994, mean alpha error 0.0002. Against mascara.json: IoU 0.944.
files.purpose: cutout: the reference mask. In both configurations the site's mask must match it with an IoU of at least 0.98 and a mean alpha error of at most 0.01.

source.how: Traced by hand over foto.jpg before any model ran on it (outline of the dog, and the grass between its front legs as a hole); the spec fills it with the even-odd rule.

files.purpose: cutout: the subject's outline, independent of any model. The site's mask (alpha of 128 or more) must overlap it with an IoU of at least 0.85.

source.author: Coconino National Forest (USDA Forest Service), published on Flickr
source.title: Bear Mountain Trail No. 54
source.note: The 960 × 638 rendering that Wikimedia Commons serves of the CC0 original, with its metadata segments (EXIF and colour profile) removed; the image data is unchanged.

files.purpose: depth: a photo with something clearly near (the trail sign) and clearly far (the red rock on the hill).

source.made: ELFFUSS_AI_DEPTH_GOLDEN=write in configuration B (Chrome without WebGPU): the depth page on foto.jpg with the WASM fp32 variant, saved through its 16-bit download.

files.purpose: depth: the reference map (16-bit grey, 0-1 stored as 0-65535, lighter is nearer) that every backend must correlate with.

source.made: Marked by hand, looking at foto.jpg; the spec reads it.

files.purpose: depth: rectangles of the near sign, the juniper in the middle and the far rock, for the near-beats-far check.

source.how: Drawn by hand on foto.jpg before any model ran on it: the smallest box around everything visible of each animal, tails included, in pixels of the image (no script makes them).

files.purpose: detect: the hand boxes every detection is checked against (image, camera and decoder tests)

source.author: Gerda Arendt
source.note: The 960 × 720 rendition that Wikimedia Commons serves of the original photo, unchanged. The file page gives CC0 1.0 (own work of its author, no attribution required).

files.purpose: detect: a photo with two COCO classes, a dog and a cat, for the image test, the fake camera and the decoder's reference outputs

source.note: Written by its test of the decoder's reference outputs when ELFFUSS_AI_UPDATE_DETECT_OUTPUTS=1: the raw outputs of the model for foto.jpg, fed the normalised input RF-DETR was trained on, the 40 queries with the highest scores.

files.purpose: detect: real logits and boxes for the unit test of the decoder
